We propose Iterative Conversational Query Reformulation (IterCQR) model, that iteratively performs query reformulation … enabling the utility of off‑the‑shelf retrievers.
We propose IterCQR which iteratively trains a conversational query reformulation model without human label while utilizing off-the-shelf retrievers.
Our model evaluates retrieval performance on commonly used metrics, such as mean reciprocal rank (MRR), NDCG@3, Recall@10, and Recall@100
